_comment: EXECUTOR AUTHORING session permissions (Milestone 7), the executor-side mirror of watchdog.settings.json. The agent edits its own planner (AUTHORING_SESSION_DIR/planner, under executor/workspace/<condition>/) and evaluates it through the executor-authoring MCP server; it needs no shell. The session's own bookkeeping (session.json, runner logs per episode) is written under records/authoring/, which is denied, because it carries the checker outcome. Read is allowed for the executor-side repo (task file, executor parts, platform config, backend sources) and DENIED for everything WatchDog-side and for the episode records: records/ holds the ground-truth checker result and the WatchDog transcript, which reach the agent only through read_verdict, filtered by config/cell.yaml executor_feedback. Bash is denied because a shell bypasses every rule here (it could cat records/ or run the runner directly). Agent, Task and Workflow are denied because subagents read under their own permissions; Artifact, ShareOnboardingGuide, WebFetch and WebSearch are outbound channels. Edits are allowed only under executor/workspace/. Re-verify the tool list after a Claude Code upgrade: a tool added later is permitted by default.
_run_params_comment: RUN PARAMETERS: model and effortLevel, as in watchdog.settings.json. runner/run_authoring.sh passes this file with --settings and echoes both values.
_condition_comment: CONDITION plan_free (runner/run_authoring.sh --condition plan_free): the agent gets only the goal, constraints and object descriptions (config/tasks/<assembly>.plan_free.yaml via get_task) and the part data, and starts from executor/planner_templates/plan_free, a skeleton with no assembly logic. Identical to the plan_given settings plus read denies on every place the plan, or the v1 executor's pick/place know-how, is written: the task files (the full one carries steps and offsets), the plan_given template and sessions, tools/pick_check.py, robot_backend's test plans (grasp offsets per part), skills and executor MCP servers, and .git. Other plan_free sessions under executor/workspace/plan_free/ stay readable (a deny would also cover the agent's own).
_rules_comment: Path rules: Read(path) also covers Glob and Grep, Edit(path) also covers Write; Claude Code ignores Glob(path) and Write(path) rules and warns about them.
